# Townsville Skip Bins

> Skip bins in Townsville, Kirwan, Douglas, Deeragun, Bushland Beach and Kelso. Tell us your suburb, size and waste type and get a free quote from one local skip bin operator.

Townsville Skip Bins (townsvilleskipbins.com) is a free skip bin quote and referral service, not a skip hire company. It is run by Raf Web Studio. Visitors fill in a two-step quote form (suburb, skip size, waste type, then contact details) and the request goes to one local skip bin operator, who quotes, supplies the skip and sets the price and hire terms.

- Service: skip bin hire quotes
- Area: Townsville, Townsville City Council (QLD), including Townsville City, North Ward, South Townsville, Railway Estate, Hermit Park, Mundingburra, Aitkenvale, Garbutt, Wulguru, Stuart, Annandale, Douglas, Idalia, Cranbrook, Heatley, Kirwan, Thuringowa Central, Condon, Rasmussen, Kelso, Deeragun, Bushland Beach, Burdell, Mount Low
- Contact: the quote form on the homepage (no phone line, no payments taken)
- Prices: no price list; a local operator will quote for each job

## Quick answers

- **What areas does Townsville Skip Bins cover, and is there a call-out fee?** We take skip bin quote requests from Townsville and nearby areas, including Townsville City, North Ward, South Townsville, Railway Estate, Hermit Park, Mundingburra, Aitkenvale, Garbutt, Wulguru, Stuart, Annandale, Douglas, Idalia, Cranbrook, Heatley, Kirwan, Thuringowa Central, Condon, Rasmussen, Kelso, Deeragun, Bushland Beach, Burdell, Mount Low. The quote service is free, so there's no call-out fee from us. The operator includes delivery and pick-up in its quote. Deliveries out to the northern beaches or rural areas, extra hire days and difficult access can add to the price.
- **Do I need a licence or permit for a skip bin?** You don't need a licence to hire a skip. A skip wholly on your own property generally doesn't need approval. In the road reserve, such as the road or footpath, yes: Townsville City Council requires an approval for works on public areas and roads. Asbestos is different: asbestos can't go in a general skip. In Queensland, more than 10 m² of bonded asbestos needs a licensed removalist or a Queensland Health-approved homeowner's certificate, and friable asbestos needs a Class A licensed removalist.
- **What affects the price of a skip bin?** Skip bin prices depend on the bin size, the type and weight of the waste, how long you keep the bin, how far the truck travels and how easy access is. We don't publish a price list. Tell us about your job and a local operator will quote for it.
- **Who supplies the skip?** Townsville Skip Bins is a free referral and quote service run by Raf Web Studio. We don't own skips or trucks. We pass your request to one local skip bin operator who services your area, and they quote, supply the skip and set the hire terms.
